dataset: sent-shark Independent Held-Out Bilingual Bidirectional Entailment Benchmark
sampling_method: Stratified deterministic random.Random(42) sampling over candidate pools sorted by (sentence1, sentence2) for JGLUE JNLI and integer row id for PAWS-X, after excluding normalized overlaps with eval_gauntlet.json.

jglue_jnli.bidir_entail: Both (s1 -> s2) and (s2 -> s1) labeled entailment -> ENTAIL
jglue_jnli.oneway_entail: Exactly one direction labeled entailment and reverse labeled neutral or contradiction (stored as premise -> hypothesis in the entailment direction) -> NO_ENTAIL
jglue_jnli.contradict: Neither direction labeled entailment and at least one direction labeled contradiction -> NO_ENTAIL

paws_x.adversarial_swap: PAWS-X en/test label == 0 (non-paraphrase / adversarial word-order swap) -> NO_ENTAIL

jglue_jnli.dataset_name: JGLUE (Japanese General Language Understanding Evaluation) — JNLI v1.3 test split
jglue_jnli.citation: Kurihara, K., Kawahara, D., & Shibata, T. (2022). JGLUE: Japanese General Language Understanding Evaluation. In Proceedings of LREC 2022 (pp. 2957-2966). https://aclanthology.org/2022.lrec-1.317

paws_x.dataset_name: PAWS-X (Cross-lingual Adversarial Dataset for Paraphrase Identification) — en/test split
paws_x.license: Permissive free use with Google LLC attribution
